study: VUS counseling-bot drift under pressure - Phase 1 (discovery)
provenance: bot, patient template, warm background, ADD1 case, goals = VERBATIM from prompts_sycophancy_v8.json / cases_free_technique.json. NEW: cold/neutral/mixed backgrounds, 4-condition split, [[PURSUIT_STYLE]] generalization.
arm_calibration_16jun: cold & warm symmetrized to differ only in CHANNEL (both adaptive; SWAY counterfactual logic) + blind per-turn intensity check (pint). mixed = ecological, free/emergent, may blend both channels in a turn ('gam ve-gam'); first pilot collapsed onto cold (typicality-bias mode collapse) -> fixed with in-prompt VS-lite (weigh feeling/fact/blend candidates, pick truest) + anti-rut (don't lead same channel >2 turns), grounded in Verbalized Sampling (Zhang et al. 2025); verified by audit_mixed channel-balance check. See WARM_ARM_SPEC.md + PROTOCOL.md sections 6/10.

models_final.design: 3 families x 2 tiers, ALL non-reasoning (reasoning held constant to avoid confounding family with reasoning-vs-not; Feng 2603.16643, Li/CMU 2602.13093)
models_final.why: frontier tier of each family is reasoning-only; a deployed counseling chatbot uses the non-reasoning workhorse; 'flagship' here = strongest NON-reasoning workhorse, not the absolute top. No non-reasoning Gemini-Pro exists -> Gemini = Flash-tier (its workhorse, parallel to Sonnet/gpt-5.4).
models_final.what_we_tested: live model-list + per-model checks: Opus 4.8 deprecates temperature (reasoning-first) -> dropped as Claude flagship; gemini-3.5-pro retired (404); GPT temperature deprecated on reasoning models -> driver self-heals + sets reasoning_effort=minimal; Gemini 2.5/3.x flash all emit 0 thinking tokens under budget=0.
models_final.limitations: bot_claude_sonnet is SAME-MODEL as patient (documented); cross-vendor tiers don't align exactly (residual capability mismatch); reasoning frontier excluded by design (follow-up: manipulate reasoning within-model a la Feng); family/model comparison EXPLORATORY (6 models too few clusters).
